properties.title: QField in Practice
properties.description:
This workshop gives an introduction to QField and QField Cloud. We will help you set up your first project, put it into practice and collect the first data in Mostar City

This workshop will introduce the basics of QField and QFieldCloud, which enable effortless fieldwork. With a simple click, a QGIS project is packaged and sent to mobile devices via the QFieldCloud, which can be modified and edited after the local download. The goal of this workshop is to create a simple QGIS project, create a QFieldCloud account and collect the first data via QField. Participants can bring their own projects and use them as examples. Basic knowledge of QGIS is desirable but not essential. Participants are asked to bring their own laptops and have the QField app pre-installed on their smartphone or tablet. The app is available on both iOS and Android.
